A '''jail''' existed in or near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Both [[Freon Drevan]] and [[Niai Fieso]], two [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] and former [[Freon Drevan's bootlegging business|business]] partners, were taken there after [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fighting]] in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]].
